claims: Thousands of passengers are stranded across Europe due to widespread flight cancellations and delays.
Widespread flight cancellations and delays heavily impact major hubs like London, Paris, Amsterdam, and Frankfurt.
Recent disruption has grounded flights for British Airways.
Recent disruption has grounded flights for Lufthansa.
Recent disruption has grounded flights for KLM.
Major disruptions are reported at London Heathrow (UK).
Major disruptions are reported at Amsterdam Schiphol (Netherlands).
Major disruptions are reported at Paris Charles de Gaulle (France).
Major disruptions are reported at Frankfurt (Germany).
Major disruptions are reported at Madrid (Spain).
The chaos is driven by labor shortages.
The chaos is driven by technical issues.
The chaos is driven by adverse winter weather (snow and high winds).
Adverse winter weather affects flight operations and safety.
Affected airlines include British Airways, Lufthansa, KLM, EasyJet, SAS, and Air France.
Recent data highlights over 1,000 flights being delayed within a single, short period.
Recent data highlights dozens of flights cancelled within a single, short period.
Affected passengers may be eligible for compensation up to €600 under European regulations (EU261).
Eligibility for compensation under EU261 depends on the cause of the disruption.
